channel.description: Which RISC-V distribution runs on which board, where to get images, and the pitfalls to expect.

item.title: Boards — Zhihe A210 (XuanTie MelonPi dev board)
item.description: 8-core 64-bit RISC-V: 4× C920 @1.9GHz + 4× C908 @1.9GHz, all with RVV (128-bit); NPU 12 TOPS@INT8 supporting INT4/INT8/FP8/FP16/BF16 and Transformers; LPDDR4X up to 16GB; eMMC5.1; H.265 decode 4K@120fps; the board is a SODIMM compute module plus V1/V2/V3 open carrier boards, 8GB LPDDR4X + 32GB eMMC (figures from a third-party project page)
